label: Postgres: Update Rows
description: Update matching rows: SET columns from a JSON object, WHERE from a SQL condition (its $1-style placeholders read from whereParams). Emits the changed rows.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The database's connection (wire a PostgresAccess node, or a PostgresDatabase's access output).

inputs.name: where
inputs.label: Where
inputs.description: SQL condition the rows must match; write `true` to update every row.

outputs.name: rows
outputs.description: The changed rows as the database stored them.
